Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: It prematurely marked the request as satisfied and provided a BioMart/Ensembl 113 URL (a 2024 release, ROS_Cfam_1.0) instead of a proper downloads link for the dog reference files relevant in May 2020 (e.g., CanFam3.1/Ensembl r100–101, UCSC canFam3, or NCBI GCF_000002285.3). This ignored the time constraint and yielded a gene-specific page rather than the correct file directory.
